description: In crates/core/src/error.rs, UsenetIpfsError, ValidationError, ProtocolError, and SigningError all derive Clone. StorageError does not. This inconsistency means StorageError values cannot be stored in Arc<StorageError> for sharing across tasks, cannot be used as the error type in futures that require Clone bounds, and cannot be trivially converted to UsenetIpfsError::Storage for uniform error handling at call sites that need to clone the error. Fix: add #[derive(Clone)] to StorageError. All variant fields (String, LogEntryId, Cid) already implement Clone.
title: StorageError missing Clone unlike all other core error types
